verdict.rationale: Codegen provides a CLI (with TUI) to view agents, pull agent work/branches locally, and a Python SDK/API to programmatically interact with running agents, plus Slack integration for interacting with the agent in-chat — suggesting some ability to monitor/redirect agent tasks across surfaces. However, there is no explicit evidence of 'taking over' a live in-progress task mid-execution (e.g., pausing, injecting new instructions into a running session, or resuming control in an editor/IDE) — the CLI/SDK descriptions focus on viewing, pulling, and creating agents rather than live handoff/redirection of an active run. missing for 10: explicit documentation of pausing/interrupting an in-progress run, editor-based takeover (IDE session control), and redirecting a running agent's task rather than just viewing/pulling completed work or starting new prompts.
